title: SemiAnalysis tours Envision&\#x27;s 800MW Galaxy AI campus in Inner Mongolia
summary: SemiAnalysis published a firsthand report on Envision Group&\#x27;s Galaxy datacenter campus in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, planned for up to 800MW of IT capacity and built to suit two unnamed internet giants. The first 120MW phase was delivered within a year at one-fifth of US costs, according to the report, while the rest of the campus remained an active construction site. Envision&\#x27;s vertical integration includes building its own wind farms and a dedicated power line, a blade factory across the road, in-house low-voltage power modules and an 800V system, battery storage, and a co-designed prefabricated substation. SemiAnalysis also reported nearly 30,000 construction workers across 22 datacenter projects in the surrounding Chahar High-tech Zone, citing a local report.
